title: 0.05 unit insulin resolution
body: I only use 19 units of Humalog per day and often do microboluses of 0.05-0.1 units since my Tandem t:Slim allows for that small of a bolus. When I go into xDrip+ to add a treatment it allows me to enter 0.05 but displays it as 0.1. Any chance you guys can simply go in and reduce the resolution size for that entry? Thank you

comments.body: Indeed, it is possible. For carbs, up to three decimal digits are shown on the top right, which does not make much sense for carbs:

> Indeed, it is possible. 

Do you mean it is possible to use xDrip as is to do what the poster requests?
He is showing that xDrip currently rounds the second decimal point.

Or, do you mean it is possible to change xDrip to do what the poster requests?

This is for insulin boluses not carbs.

Thanks!

Currently, we focus on bug fixes and implementation of unit tests. At some point, we will implement this request.
